Kratak opis:
The Joma Propulsion football boots are intended for professional players who are looking for an incredibly lightweight boot with the best fit. Each element, from the sole to the glove-like fit, has been created using the latest technology.
\nThe exterior is made of high-quality Micro-PU, which is water-resistant and lightweight - WATER RESISTANT technology. This high-quality microfibre is highly resistant to increase the lifespan of the boot. ONE PIECE technology - sewn in one piece without seams to improve the fit and reduce the weight. With M COUNTER technology, a heel counter which provides greater protection and comfort thanks to its ergonomic shape. Piece made of PVC and Foam.
\nSmooth EVA insole to provide cushioning which absorbs the impact of the tread.
\nInner sole made of PVC up until the central area to maintain the firm structure of the studs.
\nMulti-stud 09 Mate sole. With 14 thin studs strategically placed according to the biomechanics of the footprint and joined together by a reinforcing structure. The last is rounded to integrate with the 360 degree system, which makes sure that the inner cavity of the boot is equal to the anatomy of the foot.

\n

Uključuje gumeno pojačanje s unutarnje strane u području za zaštitu cipele od trljanja i prednje mikrovlakana za otpornost na trenje s prednje strane. Uložak je izrađen od termoformiranog EVA kako bi se prilagodio obliku stopala, a platforma je od 2 mm EVA prošivena na šavove.
